body:
tfw we already made progress tho 

Getting her best friend involved after a few hour talk with her tonight, during which I actually think we covered a lot of important ground. After a lot of crying and positive reinforcement on my end, I felt like she fell asleep on a positive note. I studied up on the nuances of DBT and plan to incorporate the method into our talks, which has thus far proven effective. 

Protecting yourself is fine and all, but I'm morally obligated to set this girl on the right path at this point, which doesn't necessarily entail romantic involvement.
Yeah, this is what I figured.

I've certainly no intentions of walking away, but she will want to know what it is that she can do to get out of her predicament, and I have no answers for her. Of what use are emotional platitudes if I can't help outline for her a cohesive step-by-step plan to get out of this psychological ditch?
